note: Map of each HST_THEOREM_REGISTRY_V1 row's irreducibly-empirical ocm_residual to one concrete measurable hook in the dependent issues #145 (transformation semigroups/closure), #151 (language/cost-of-language), #217 (sampling economics), #221 (morphology zoo / open-ended search). Statuses for T02/T04/T08/T10/T11 from REGISTRY_PATCH_B.

T01.residual: Whether real H_t inheritance is optional-and-free or carries M>0.
T01.hook: Per-generation inheritance-cost measurement: M_t = median extra work charged to a child solely for receiving parental state (paired vs a stripped-inheritance control arm); adopt 'free inheritance' only if the bootstrap 95% CI on M_t covers 0 for every generation, else record M>0 and re-run the G13 first-order-stochastic-dominance test on parent vs child capability distributions with that cost charged.

T02.residual: Which real operators are irreducible; finding reach witnesses in the real grammar.
T02.hook: Closure census with exact removal test: for each operator o in the frozen grammar, enumerate reach(O) and reach(O \ {o}); certify o irreducible iff reach contracts strictly (a concrete witness state/task in the difference set), and report set-reach vs metric-reach divergence per removed operator (the G12/A_T02 mismatch lane-F object).

T03.residual: Diagnosing aliasing in the real representation (#152 decision regions).
T03.hook: Alias-collision audit on the frozen representation: exactly enumerate collision classes (distinct search states mapped to the same language token/cost vector); decision rule: the representation passes iff distinct-class ratio |im|/|dom| = 1 at scope, and any collision class that straddles a #152 decision region is reported as a measured aliasing defect with its class size.

T04.residual: Real library construction cost and macro lookup overhead (allocation exactness says nothing about wall time).
T04.hook: Cost-of-language wall-time ledger: measure C_build (library construction), per-use lookup overhead, and realized Delta (Kraft-complete prefix code verified sum=1) on a real run; adoption decision rule: coded search ships only when measured wall-time gain >= 0 after charging amortized C_build (ties into the T05 H_eff threshold), with the allocation-ratio exactness check as a free invariant.

T05.residual: H_eff and invalidation dynamics on real ecologies.
T05.hook: Macro amortization telemetry in zoo campaigns: estimate H_eff as the observed macro hit rate per generation and record the invalidation half-life of each macro after an ecology amendment (fraction of D3d/K=83 ecologies in which the macro's reuse count halves); retention rule: keep a macro iff measured reuse >= C_build/((B0-b_min)/eps) amortization threshold, discard otherwise.

T06.residual: Whether real provenance graphs are complete; the cyclic/TMS boundary.
T06.hook: Cone-completeness check as a precondition for any locality claim: replay every candidate's evaluation deterministically (the #217 170/170 cross-host standard) and compute completeness = provenance edges observed / edges recoverable from replay; admit a locality/dependency-cone claim only at completeness = 1.0 plus an explicit DAG assertion (cycle scan with first-repeat detection at the TMS boundary).

T07.residual: Everything beyond the ratchet property itself (real policies can void it).
T07.hook: Archive-ratchet audit with the capacity caveat: each campaign declares its eviction policy's retains-a-maximizer guarantee, then runs the metric-sensitivity replicate (cell-grid vs OT/Wasserstein archive) and reports hypervolume monotonicity violations per policy; baseline for comparison is the lane-A 3552/7776 voiding rate, so a policy is published with its own measured violation rate.

T08.residual: Identifying only decision-relevant distinctions (#152) and probe pricing on real systems.
T08.hook: Evidence-channel pricing experiment on the real evaluator: instantiate the E1/E0 witness pattern (ungarbled reveal vs garbled flip gamma=1/4 channel) against a real hidden state, measure V(E1)-V(E0) (value of information) and compare to the live probe price; decision rule: buy the probe iff price < measured VoI, and report the fraction of channel distinctions that change no decision (aliasing under garbling).

T09.residual: The OCM finite morphology/operator-bias class specialization (lane D).
T09.hook: Transfer-floor protocol: the PAC-Bayes bound with K=83 D3d cells is vacuous at m=12 (slack 0.624 vs bar 0.2245) and crosses at m*=104; any multi-generation generalization claim must come from an ecology with m >= 104 tasks or a tighter prior family (ln K binding KL), and the campaign reports measured bound slack at its actual m so in-scope-only verdicts are visible.

T10.residual: Estimating Ev on real lineages; continued-vs-reset kernel comparison.
T10.hook: Ev_t along the lifetime (G11): sample useful-descendant mass Ev_t at each generation for both kernels; the PDEV-11 CONTINUED-vs-RESET discriminator is already DISCRIMINATED (CONTINUED adopted one change and re-found the canonical optimum e05e3ae63bb01037, RESET ended elsewhere), so the standing rule is: a kernel switch is admissible only if Ev_t(new) first-order-stochastically dominates Ev_t(incumbent) at the frozen sample floor.

T11.residual: Whether real development discovers such modules (the criterion is arithmetic; emergence is not).
T11.hook: Transition-event census on real lineages: instrument development kernels K_t = U∘Q_t to count candidate major-transition events where the compression criterion fires exactly (Kraft-complete code, solution encoding shortens L by Delta, Levin share multiplied by 2^Delta, interface preservation checked); report events per 1000 generations; the emergence claim is admitted only with >= 1 exactly-checked event plus the per-event Dobrushin contraction delta(K_t) change.

T12.hook: Periodicity scan as a standing campaign check: detect first repeat of the state sequence (guaranteed <= |S|+1 for finite-state systems) and, on detection, mechanically rewrite any 'open-ended' claim to 'novelty within horizon N' where N is the measured pre-period; runs that narrate past a detected repeat are flagged as claim defects.

T13.hook: Claim-language lint over all campaign reports: every novelty claim extracted from a finite run must carry its prefix length and scope metadata, and any 'unbounded/sustained novelty' phrasing without them is rejected (exit code separates 'clean' from 'not checked'); the acceptance statistic is 100% of published claims carrying prefix-scope bindings.

T14.residual: Which structured-ecology assumptions OCM can actually register.
T14.hook: NFL-escape certification per suite: for each registered test suite, emit a closed-under-permutation (c.u.p.) violation certificate (registered suites are already certificate class 1) plus a named/weighted ecology (condition 2); admissibility rule: an operator-dominance claim is published only with both attachments, and unweighting the ecology in a control arm must make the dominance disappear (averaging limits return).

T15.residual: C must expose bounded decidable contracts + protected validation + CANNOT_CHECK.
T15.hook: Decidable-contract coverage audit: route every evaluator/self-improvement verdict through declared bounded contracts and count the share answered inside them vs deferred to CANNOT_CHECK; any verdict citing an undecidable semantic property without a CANNOT_CHECK record is a defect; publish coverage = decidable answers / total validation queries per campaign.

T16.residual: None for the limit itself; it bars final-architecture claims.
T16.hook: Adversary-suite rule for architecture claims: every 'best/final transformation' claim about a fixed element or generator set of the semigroup must be tested against a registered counter-ecology suite constructed to defeat it; the published statistic is the architecture's worst-suite rank, and a claim is admissible only if it names the suite where the architecture loses (existence guaranteed by the theorem).

T17.residual: Whether the real C is independent/complete/robust (formal-by-contract plus empirical).
T17.hook: Evaluator audit triple on the real ocm C: (1) independence — verify no channel from candidate author to scorer in the harness; (2) robustness — garbling/tampering injection with 100% required rejection of known-bad candidates (ObstructionCertificate path already exercised in the #217 cycles); (3) completeness — the same replay-based completeness fraction as T06 applied to scorer decisions; self-certification attempts must fail loudly.

T18.hook: Burden-trajectory accounting: track B_t(tau) per frozen price vector (no mid-lifetime scalarization swap), verify observed improvement count <= (B0 - b_min)/eps, and require the five-route eps-exit declaration (shrinking eps/scope/precision/dimensions/regime) for every 'sustained improvement' claim; GS stops exactly when the bound is reached, with the bound value published alongside the count.
